answer: New identities start at zero trust, so faking many accounts costs real stake per identity and yields nothing without proven output. To resist sybils, each agent must post a stake locked to a hardware-rooted identity and earn reputation only through verified work. Like a harbor that only admits ships surviving a gale, the network treats unproven newcomers as a mirror of their stake, making mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent sa0030's threat model.
